anomalies.description: Two individuals engage in mutual physical combat inside a doorway: one person (in dark clothing) grabs and pushes the other (holding a crate), who resists and pushes back; the interaction involves direct contact, grappling, and reciprocal force.

A second physical confrontation occurs further down the hallway: one person is on the ground while the other stands over them and delivers a kick/strike; the standing individual then appears to grab or lift the fallen person.
Two individuals engage in a sustained physical fight in a narrow hallway, involving grappling, striking, and dynamic movement including kicks and throws.

Two individuals engage in close-quarters physical combat: one delivers a punch to the other's head (f0), followed by grappling and a counter-strike (f1–f3), culminating in one person being knocked down (f4–f5).

After the opponent is on the ground (f5), the attacker continues to assault the helpless victim with repeated kicks and stomps while the victim lies motionless or attempts to shield themselves (f6–f15).
Initial physical confrontation where the standing person appears to strike or push the other, who is falling or already on the ground; ambiguous whether mutual combat occurs before full subjugation.

A standing person repeatedly kicks and strikes a prone individual on the floor in a narrow corridor.; A person in dark clothing is on the floor, appearing incapacitated or restrained, while a standing woman in a dark coat leans over them and appears to strike or press down on them; the victim remains motionless on the ground throughout this interval.

The victim remains lying on the floor near a partially closed metal shutter, while the standing person moves away slightly but remains nearby, maintaining a posture suggesting control or threat; no active striking is visible, but the context of prior abuse and continued proximity supports ongoing abusive situation.
